requirements.label: UCAT ANZ and multiple mini-interview
requirements.details: Take UCAT ANZ in the application year. Competitive scores are used to invite applicants to a multiple mini-interview. UQ does not accept ISAT for this route.

source.title: UQ Doctor of Medicine provisional entry, international selection

requirements.label: Provisional entry · school-leaver eligibility and progression
requirements.details: Apply during your first attempt at the final year of secondary education. The academic prerequisite is Queensland Year 12 General English, Units 3 and 4 at grade C or equivalent. After a provisional offer, complete the UQ bachelor degree in the required time and earn at least 5.0/7.0 in undergraduate study. The first degree sets the English-language score.

source.title: UQ Doctor of Medicine provisional entry, eligibility and progression

requirements.label: Direct international provisional entry · 2027 closing date
requirements.details: For eligible direct international applications for 2027 entry, the closing date was 30 September 2026. Use programme code 2303. Applicants completing Australian Year 12 or IB in Australia follow the QTAC instructions instead.

source.title: UQ provisional medicine 2027 application routes and deadlines
